editorial:
Imagine being stuck in a small town where every single day feels exactly the same. That is exactly how Emma Bovary feels in this movie. She is married to a kind but very boring doctor who has no idea that his wife is miserable. Emma spends her time reading romance novels and dreaming of a fancy, exciting life in the city. Because she is so bored and lonely, she starts cheating on her husband and spending way more money than she actually has on expensive clothes and home decor. It feels like a slow-motion train wreck because you can see her getting into deeper trouble, but she just cannot stop searching for a thrill.

What really makes this version work is the acting and the beautiful costumes. The lead actress does a great job showing how Emma goes from being hopeful to completely desperate. Some parts might feel a bit slow if you like high-action movies, but it is perfect if you enjoy a good character study.
endingExplained: Everything falls apart when Emma's debts pile up and her lovers leave her. She realizes she has no way out and no one left to help her. In a state of total panic and sadness, she swallows poison to end her life. Her husband finds her too late, and she dies in pain. The story ends with the sad realization that her search for a perfect life ended up destroying everything she had.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic stories about forbidden romance and luxury.
